sop_snippets.applicable_when: 부서 R&D 비용이 총 운영비의 50% 초과 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: If a business unit's R&D cost allocation exceeds 50% of its total operational expenses, the unit must demonstrate a minimum of 20% Quarter-over-Quarter revenue growth. Otherwise, a strategic review is required to prevent misaligned investments.
Business units with headcount exceeding 100 must maintain a minimum performance score of 80 to qualify for standard baseline funding.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 부서별 간접비 배분 또는 비용 분류 판단 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: Indirect costs shall be allocated proportionally by department headcount. Special project costs are directly attributed to the originating unit. If indirect cost exceeds 30% of direct costs, a detailed allocation review is triggered.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 전분기 대비 30% 이상 변동 발생 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: Quarterly variations exceeding 30% from the previous quarter are automatically flagged. Variations exceeding 50% require immediate review and formal justification to the Board.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 분기별 준법 보고 시 또는 규정 위반 의심 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: All compliance incidents must be reported within 48 hours of discovery. Quarterly compliance summaries are mandatory for units exceeding 50 employees.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 분기 이사회 보고 시 또는 중대 리스크 발생 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: Material risks with estimated financial impact exceeding 5% of quarterly revenue must be escalated to the Board within 72 hours. All escalations require documented SOP references.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 신규 프로젝트 착수 시 또는 연간 리스크 평가 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: Risk assessments must use the standardized 5x5 impact-likelihood matrix. Projects with residual risk scores above 15 require executive sponsor approval before proceeding.

sop_snippets.applicable_when: 정보보안 사고 발생 시 또는 의심 징후 탐지 시
sop_snippets.rule_text: Security incidents must be triaged within 1 hour of detection. Data breach events require immediate isolation of affected systems and notification to DPO within 4 hours.
